Parameter to is only meaningful as the recipient input of _transfer and is fully subsumed by that function node
Parameter amount is used solely for limit checks and fee computation inside _transfer
Parameter tokens is consumed entirely by the swapAndLiquify split logic

Local unitBalance is an intermediate scaling value used only inside swapAndLiquify
Local marketingAmt exists only as the value passed to the marketing ETH transfer
Local devAmt exists only as the value passed to the dev ETH transfer
Parameter account is the blacklist target and has no meaning outside addBotToBlacklist
Parameter time is the lock duration consumed by lock and does not exist independently
